en.title: ITRP Regulations (AIFC Regulations No. 57 of 2026): "Tax Code" is the repealed Code No. 120-VI in the English and Kazakh texts, and sections 29(2) and 30(2) restate rules that current law no longer contains
en.summary: AIFC Regulations No. 57 of 2026 on the AIFC Investment Tax Residency Programme (6 August 2026) replaced AIFC Act No. 42 of 2022 (section 3). The English and Kazakh texts of its Schedule define "Tax Code" as the Code of 25 December 2017 No. 120-VI, which was repealed on 1 January 2026. The Russian text gives only the name of the Code, without a date or number; under Article 2(5) of the Tax Code of 18 July 2025 No. 214-VIII that name now refers to the current Code, so the language versions point to different Codes. Sections 29(2) and 30(2), carried over from Act No. 42 word for word, restate rules of Article 218(2) of the 2017 Code: the investment resident provides, "along with other documents determined by the Tax Code", the AIFC Authority's confirmation letter, and the residency certificate "is issued for the year in which the fee ... was paid". Under the 2025 Code these documents are no longer in the Code: Article 224(1) leaves the procedure to the authorised body, and the list for an AIFC investment resident, including the confirmation letter, is in item 8(6) of the list of requirements to the Rules approved by Order of the Minister of Finance of 11 November 2025 No. 689. The 2025 Code and Order No. 689 do not keep the fee-year rule: Article 224(3)(3) confirms residency for the calendar year stated in the application and Article 224(4) for the past and (or) the current year. For example, an investor who pays the fee in January 2026 and asks for confirmation for 2025 would get a certificate for 2026 under section 30(2), while Article 224(4) allows 2025. Sections 29(1) and 30(1) refer to the acting tax legislation, so residency itself follows current law, but section 30(2) states a period that current law does not set.
en.correction: Please update the definition of "Tax Code" in the English and Kazakh texts to the Code of 18 July 2025 No. 214-VIII (and give the date and number in the Russian text), refer in section 29(2) to the documents set by the rules of the authorised body (currently Order No. 689 of 11 November 2025), and align section 30(2) with Article 224 of the Code, or delete it.

ru.title: Регламент МФЦА о программе инвестиционного налогового резидентства (№ 57 2026 года): в английском и казахском текстах «Налоговый кодекс» — утративший силу Кодекс № 120-VI, а статьи 29(2) и 30(2) воспроизводят нормы, которых действующее право больше не содержит
ru.summary: Регламент МФЦА № 57 2026 года о программе инвестиционного налогового резидентства МФЦА (6 августа 2026 года) заменил акт МФЦА № 42 2022 года (статья 3). Английский и казахский тексты приложения к нему определяют «Налоговый кодекс» как Кодекс от 25 декабря 2017 года № 120-VI, утративший силу 1 января 2026 года. Русский текст приводит только наименование Кодекса, без даты и номера; согласно пункту 5 статьи 2 Налогового кодекса от 18 июля 2025 года № 214-VIII это наименование теперь обозначает действующий Кодекс, так что языковые версии указывают на разные кодексы. Статьи 29(2) и 30(2), дословно перенесённые из акта № 42, воспроизводят нормы пункта 2 статьи 218 Кодекса 2017 года: инвестиционный резидент представляет «наряду с другими документами, определёнными Налоговым кодексом», письмо-подтверждение Администрации МФЦА, а документ, подтверждающий резидентство, «выдается за календарный год, в котором произведена уплата сбора за выдачу документа, подтверждающего резидентство Республики Казахстан в целях Налогового кодекса». По Кодексу 2025 года эти документы в самом Кодексе больше не названы: пункт 1 статьи 224 оставляет порядок уполномоченному органу, а перечень документов для инвестиционного резидента МФЦА, включая письмо-подтверждение, содержится в подпункте 6) пункта 8 перечня требований к Правилам, утверждённым приказом Министра финансов от 11 ноября 2025 года № 689. Кодекс 2025 года и приказ № 689 не сохраняют правило о годе уплаты сбора: подпункт 3) пункта 3 статьи 224 предусматривает подтверждение резидентства за календарный год, указанный в заявлении, а пункт 4 статьи 224 — «за прошедший и (или) текущий календарные годы». Например, инвестор, уплативший сбор в январе 2026 года и запросивший подтверждение за 2025 год, по статье 30(2) получил бы документ за 2026 год, тогда как пункт 4 статьи 224 допускает 2025 год. Статьи 29(1) и 30(1) отсылают к действующему налоговому законодательству, поэтому само резидентство определяется по действующему праву, однако статья 30(2) устанавливает период, которого действующее право не предусматривает.
ru.correction: Просим привести определение «Налогового кодекса» в английском и казахском текстах в соответствие с Кодексом от 18 июля 2025 года № 214-VIII (а в русском тексте указать его дату и номер), в статье 29(2) сослаться на документы, установленные правилами уполномоченного органа (в настоящее время — приказ № 689 от 11 ноября 2025 года), и согласовать статью 30(2) со статьёй 224 Кодекса либо исключить её.

kk.title: АХҚО инвестициялық салықтық резиденттік бағдарламасы туралы регламент (2026 жылғы № 57 АХҚО регламенті): ағылшын және қазақ тілдеріндегі мәтіндерде «Салық кодексі» күшін жойған № 120-VI Кодексті білдіреді, ал 29-баптың 2-тармағы мен 30-баптың 2-тармағы қолданыстағы құқықта енді жоқ ережелерді қайталайды
kk.summary: АХҚО инвестициялық салықтық резиденттік бағдарламасы туралы 2026 жылғы № 57 АХҚО регламенті (2026 жылғы 6 тамыз) 2022 жылғы № 42 АХҚО актісін ауыстырды (3-бап). Оның Қосымшасының ағылшын және қазақ тілдеріндегі мәтіндерінде «Салық кодексі» 2026 жылғы 1 қаңтарда күшін жойған 2017 жылғы 25 желтоқсандағы № 120-VI Кодекс ретінде айқындалған. Орыс тіліндегі мәтінде күні мен нөмірі көрсетілмей, Кодекстің атауы ғана берілген; 2025 жылғы 18 шілдедегі № 214-VIII Салық кодексінің 2-бабының 5-тармағына сәйкес бұл атау енді қолданыстағы Кодексті білдіреді, сондықтан тілдік нұсқалар әртүрлі кодекстерге сілтеме жасайды. № 42 актіден сөзбе-сөз көшірілген 29-баптың 2-тармағы мен 30-баптың 2-тармағы 2017 жылғы Кодекстің 218-бабының 2-тармағындағы ережелерді қайталайды: инвестициялық резидент «Салық кодексінде айқындалған өзге де құжаттармен бірге» АХҚО Әкімшілігінің растау хатын ұсынады, ал резиденттікті растайтын құжат «алым ... төленген жылға беріледі». 2025 жылғы Кодекс бойынша бұл құжаттар Кодексте енді жоқ: 224-баптың 1-тармағы тәртіпті белгілеуді уәкілетті органға қалдырады, ал АХҚО инвестициялық резиденті үшін құжаттар тізбесі, оның ішінде растау хаты, Қаржы министрінің 2025 жылғы 11 қарашадағы № 689 бұйрығымен бекітілген Қағидаларға қосымшадағы талаптар тізбесінің 8-тармағының 6) тармақшасында берілген. 2025 жылғы Кодекс пен № 689 бұйрықта алым төленген жыл туралы ереже сақталмаған: 224-баптың 3-тармағының 3) тармақшасына сәйкес резиденттік өтініште көрсетілген күнтізбелік жылға, ал 224-баптың 4-тармағына сәйкес өткен және (немесе) ағымдағы жылға расталады. Мысалы, алымды 2026 жылғы қаңтарда төлеп, 2025 жылға растауды сұраған инвестор 30-баптың 2-тармағы бойынша 2026 жылға құжат алар еді, ал 224-баптың 4-тармағы 2025 жылды растауға мүмкіндік береді. 29-баптың 1-тармағы мен 30-баптың 1-тармағы қолданыстағы салық заңнамасына сілтеме жасайды, сондықтан резиденттіктің өзі қолданыстағы құқыққа сәйкес айқындалады, алайда 30-баптың 2-тармағында қолданыстағы құқықта белгіленбеген кезең көрсетілген.
kk.correction: Ағылшын және қазақ тілдеріндегі мәтіндердегі «Салық кодексі» анықтамасын 2025 жылғы 18 шілдедегі № 214-VIII Кодекске сәйкес жаңартуды (орыс тіліндегі мәтінде оның күні мен нөмірін көрсетуді), 29-баптың 2-тармағында уәкілетті органның қағидаларында белгіленген құжаттарға (қазіргі уақытта 2025 жылғы 11 қарашадағы № 689 бұйрық) сілтеме жасауды және 30-баптың 2-тармағын Кодекстің 224-бабымен сәйкестендіруді немесе оны алып тастауды сұраймыз.

en.title: Consolidated V3 and V4 of the Employment Regulations drop the text of section 65-1 (Whistleblowing); only the contents entry remains
en.summary: Version 2 of the Employment Regulations (amendments as of 22 February 2019) contains Part 10-1 with section 65-1, which extends to Employees the whistleblower protections of Part 14-2 of the Companies Regulations. The later amending instruments on the act page (No. 30 of 2019 and No. 39 of 2021) do not omit it. Yet the consolidated V3 and the current V4 list "PART 10-1: WHISTLEBLOWING" in the contents but have no text for it. The full text on the aifc.kz website goes from Part 10 to Part 11 and has no Part 10-1 and no section 65-1. The act page publishes no instrument that inserted section 65-1 in February 2019, and no instrument that omitted it. Part 14-2 of the Companies Regulations still protects any Worker directly.
en.correction: Please restore Part 10-1 (section 65-1) in the consolidated text and publish the instrument that inserted it, or publish the instrument that removed it and update the contents.

en.title: Employment Regulations s.26: rest breaks of "not less than 15 hours" for a working day of more than 6 hours
en.summary: Section 26 of the Employment Regulations entitles an Employee whose working time on a day is more than 6 hours to rest breaks of "not less than 15 hours" in total; the breaks "may be spent away from the Employee's workstation". With the 8-hour limit in section 24 this makes a day of 23 hours of work and breaks, and more than 24 hours once working time exceeds 9 hours, so the figure is hard to apply as a break during work. The text has been the same since 2017. For comparison, the ADGM Employment Regulations (2015, 2019 and 2024), which have the same structure and the same 6-hour trigger, give rest breaks of not less than 1 hour in aggregate. The intended figure cannot be derived from the AIFC text itself.
en.correction: Please clarify whether the 15 hours in section 26 means breaks during work or total daily rest, and amend the figure or the wording accordingly.

en.title: Foreign-labour record rules (2018) put the reporting duty on the foreign employee; Article 8(3) of the Constitutional Statute, as amended in December 2019, names AIFC Participants and bodies
en.summary: Article 8(3) of the Constitutional Statute, as amended by Constitutional Law No. 296-VI of 30 December 2019, requires Participants and bodies of the Centre to submit information on attracted foreign nationals to the AIFC Authority "in accordance with acts of the Centre". The only implementing act we found, AIFC Rules No. 2 of 2018 (rule 2.2), puts the duty on the Foreign Employee, who may file in person or through the Employer. The two duties can coexist, but we found no act of the Centre addressed to Participants and bodies. Rule 2.2 also uses "admit" where "apply" or "submit" seems meant.
en.correction: Please indicate the act of the Centre that implements the second paragraph of Article 8(3), or consider adding to the Rules a duty addressed to Participants and bodies of the Centre.

en.title: DP Regulations 2025: section 9-2 'Right to withdraw consent' is listed and cited twice but has no text
en.summary: Section 9-1(5) twice refers to section 9-2: the right to withdraw consent "afforded ... under section 9-2" and the duty to inform the Data Subject "how to exercise it as set out in section 9-2". The contents list "9-2. Right to withdraw consent", but the text passes from section 9-1(12) directly to section 10. Section 9-1(5) itself says that consent may be withdrawn at any time, that withdrawing must be at least as easy as giving consent and that it does not affect earlier processing; section 9-1(9) requires procedures for recording withdrawal. The amending instrument of 1 April 2025 is not on the act page, so it cannot be established whether the instrument or the consolidation lost section 9-2.
en.correction: Please publish section 9-2 if it was adopted, or reconcile the references in section 9-1(5) while keeping the existing withdrawal rights and information duties.

en.title: Data Protection Regulations s.9: the lawful-basis rule is addressed to the Data Processor, while other sections treat it as the Data Controller's basis - who is bound?
en.summary: Section 9 of the Data Protection Regulations opens "A Data Processor must not Process Personal Data unless" one of grounds (a)-(e) applies. The grounds themselves refer to the Data Controller, and sections 9-1(1), 13(1)(c)(v) and 14(2)(c)(v) treat section 9 as the Controller's lawful basis. The Controller's duty to process lawfully also follows from section 8(1)(a). A Processor may well be meant to be bound too, so the text allows more than one reading of who is bound by section 9. For comparison, the corresponding ADGM provision (Data Protection Regulations 2015, section 2) opened without naming an addressee: "Personal Data may only be Processed if".
en.correction: Please clarify whether section 9 binds Data Controllers, Data Processors or both, and adjust its opening words if needed.

en.title: Court Rules fix filing and service cut-off at '4pm Alma Ata time (UTC + 6)'; Kazakhstan has used UTC+5 since 1 March 2024
en.summary: Rule 2.12 requires any act due "on or before a particular date" to be done "by 4pm Alma Ata time (UTC + 6)", and rule 5.15 treats a document "delivered before 4pm Alma Ata time (UTC + 6) on a business day" as served that day. When the Rules were written both labels meant the same time. Since 1 March 2024 the whole of Kazakhstan uses the fifth time zone, UTC+5 (Resolution of the Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 20 of 19 January 2024, amending Resolution No. 1749 of 23 November 2000). Since then "Alma Ata time" and "UTC + 6" differ by one hour: 4pm UTC+6 is 3pm local time, and 4pm local time is 5pm UTC+6.
en.correction: Please choose one time base for rules 2.12 and 5.15 - local time (for example "4pm Astana time") or a fixed offset - and remove the other label.

ru.title: Правила Суда МФЦА устанавливают крайний срок подачи и вручения «16:00 по времени Алма-Аты (UTC + 6)»; с 1 марта 2024 года в Казахстане действует UTC+5
ru.summary: Правило 2.12 требует, чтобы действие, которое должно быть совершено «в определённую дату или ранее», было совершено «до 16:00 по времени Алма-Аты (UTC + 6)», а правило 5.15 считает документ, «доставленный до 16:00 по времени Алма-Аты (UTC + 6) в рабочий день», врученным в тот же день. Когда Правила составлялись, оба обозначения означали одно и то же время. С 1 марта 2024 года на всей территории Казахстана применяется 5-й часовой пояс, UTC+5 (постановление Правительства Республики Казахстан от 19 января 2024 года № 20 о внесении изменений в постановление от 23 ноября 2000 года № 1749). С этого времени «время Алма-Аты» и «UTC + 6» расходятся на один час: 16:00 по UTC+6 — это 15:00 по местному времени, а 16:00 по местному времени — это 17:00 по UTC+6.
ru.correction: Просим выбрать для правил 2.12 и 5.15 одну основу исчисления времени — местное время (например, «16:00 по времени Астаны») или фиксированное смещение — и исключить второе обозначение.

en.title: Court Regulations s.29(2) restates Article 13(6) of the Constitutional Statute as "shall be guided by decisions"; Article 13(6) says the Court may take into account final decisions
en.summary: Section 29(2) of the AIFC Court Regulations says that the Court, "as provided by Article 13(6)" of the Constitutional Statute, "shall be guided by decisions of the Court and decisions made in other common law jurisdictions". Article 13(6) is permissive and limited to final decisions: the Court "может учитывать вступившие в законную силу решения" (may take into account final decisions). Being guided is not the same as being bound, so we do not see a clear conflict, but the restatement is not exact.
en.correction: Please consider aligning section 29(2) with the words of Article 13(6) of the Constitutional Statute.

ru.title: Регламент Суда МФЦА, статья 29(2), передаёт пункт 6 статьи 13 Конституционного закона словами «руководствуется решениями»; пункт 6 статьи 13 говорит, что суд может учитывать вступившие в законную силу решения
ru.summary: Статья 29(2) Регламента Суда МФЦА указывает, что Суд, «как предусмотрено пунктом 6 статьи 13» Конституционного закона Республики Казахстан «О Международном финансовом центре „Астана“», «руководствуется решениями Суда и решениями, вынесенными в других юрисдикциях общего права». Пункт 6 статьи 13 сформулирован как возможность и ограничен решениями, вступившими в силу: суд «может учитывать вступившие в законную силу решения». Руководствоваться решениями — не то же самое, что быть ими связанным, поэтому явного противоречия мы не видим, однако пересказ неточен.
ru.correction: Просим рассмотреть приведение статьи 29(2) в соответствие с формулировкой пункта 6 статьи 13 Конституционного закона.

en.title: Court Regulations s.13: the Chief Justice appoints temporary Judges; the Statute (art. 13(3-1), from 2018) reserves appointment of judges to the President
en.summary: Section 13(1) of the AIFC Court Regulations lets the Chief Justice, after consulting the Governor, appoint a person as a temporary Judge "to facilitate the disposal of business in the Court"; section 13(3) treats that person "for all purposes" as a Judge. The Regulations were adopted on 5 December 2017 under Article 13(5) of the Constitutional Statute (section 2). At that time Article 13(5) left to the Council resolution on the Court "the procedure for the appointment and removal of judges and other officials of the court". Constitutional Law No. 119-VI of 22 December 2017 added Article 13(3-1): the Chairman and judges of the Centre's court are appointed and released by the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan on the recommendation of the Governor. The same law deleted the words "judges and other" from Article 13(5), so the Council resolution now sets the procedure only for officials of the court. Section 12(1) of the Regulations follows Article 13(3-1) for permanent Judges; section 13 was not aligned. As written, a person appointed under section 13 would hear cases and sign judgments as a Judge without the appointment that Article 13(3-1) requires. We found no sign that section 13 has been used: the judges named in the judgments published on court.aifc.kz since April 2019 are all among the Chief Justice and Justices listed by the Court.
en.correction: Please consider amending section 13 so that temporary Judges are appointed in the manner required by Article 13(3-1) of the Constitutional Statute, or repealing it. The Court Regulations are adopted by the Management Council (section 2), so the change needs a Council resolution. Because section 13 appears not to have been used, the change can be made before any case depends on it.

ru.title: Регламент Суда МФЦА, статья 13: временных судей назначает Председатель Суда; Конституционный закон (пункт 3-1 статьи 13, с 2018 года) относит назначение судей к полномочиям Президента
ru.summary: Статья 13(1) Регламента Суда МФЦА позволяет Председателю Суда после консультации с Управляющим назначить лицо временным судьёй «для содействия рассмотрению дел в Суде»; статья 13(3) считает такое лицо судьёй «во всех отношениях». Регламент принят 5 декабря 2017 года на основании пункта 5 статьи 13 Конституционного закона Республики Казахстан «О Международном финансовом центре „Астана“» (статья 2). В то время пункт 5 статьи 13 относил к постановлению Совета о суде «порядок назначения и освобождения судей и других должностных лиц суда от должности». Конституционный закон № 119-VI от 22 декабря 2017 года дополнил статью 13 пунктом 3-1: «Председатель и судьи суда Центра назначаются и освобождаются Президентом Республики Казахстан по рекомендации Управляющего Центром». Тот же закон исключил из пункта 5 статьи 13 слова «судей и других», поэтому постановление Совета теперь устанавливает порядок только для должностных лиц суда. Статья 12(1) Регламента следует пункту 3-1 статьи 13 в отношении постоянных судей; статья 13 в соответствие приведена не была. По буквальному тексту лицо, назначенное по статье 13, рассматривало бы дела и подписывало решения в качестве судьи без назначения, которого требует пункт 3-1 статьи 13. Признаков применения статьи 13 мы не нашли: все судьи, названные в решениях, опубликованных на court.aifc.kz с апреля 2019 года, входят в состав Председателя и судей, указанный Судом.
ru.correction: Просим рассмотреть изменение статьи 13, с тем чтобы временные судьи назначались в порядке, установленном пунктом 3-1 статьи 13 Конституционного закона, либо её отмену. Регламент Суда принимается Советом по управлению (статья 2), поэтому изменение требует постановления Совета. Поскольку статья 13, по-видимому, не применялась, изменение можно внести до того, как от неё будет зависеть какое-либо дело.

en.title: IAC Rules 10.7 give 'seven days' to apply to the AIFC Court on a rejected challenge; Arbitration Regulations 22(3), which parties cannot cut, give thirty
en.summary: IAC Rules 10.7: a decision rejecting a challenge is "without prejudice to any right a party may have to apply within seven days to the AIFC Court under the Arbitration Regulations, Article 22(3)". Article 22(3) of the Arbitration Regulations gives the challenging party "thirty days after having received notice of the decision rejecting the challenge", and Article 22(1) makes any procedure agreed by the parties subject to paragraph (3). The AIFC Court Rules (rule 27.28) also fix 30 days for this application. Because rule 10.7 is "without prejudice to any right", the 30 days are not cut, but the Rules state the wrong period. The unofficial Russian translation also says "в течение семи дней" (within seven days).
en.correction: Please replace "within seven days" with "within thirty days after having received notice of the decision" in Article 10.7, or refer to Article 22(3) without stating a period.

en.title: IAC Rules 3.2 calculate periods in "Alma-Ata Time (UTC+6)" by default; Kazakhstan has used UTC+5 since 1 March 2024
en.summary: Article 3.2: "Unless the Registrar or Tribunal provide otherwise, or unless the parties agree otherwise", "any period of time is to be calculated in accordance with Alma-Ata Time (UTC+6)". Since 1 March 2024 the whole of Kazakhstan uses UTC+5 (Resolution of the Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 20 of 19 January 2024). Alma-Ata local time and UTC+6 now differ by one hour, so the default end of a day differs too (midnight local time is 01:00 UTC+6). The Registrar may extend time limits (Article 3.8), which reduces the practical effect.
en.correction: Please choose one time base in Article 3.2 - local time (for example "Astana time") or a fixed offset - and remove the other label.

ru.title: Правила МАЦ, статья 3.2: сроки по умолчанию исчисляются по «времени Алма-Аты (UTC+6)»; с 1 марта 2024 года в Казахстане действует UTC+5
ru.summary: Статья 3.2: «если регистратор или арбитражный суд не предусмотрят иное либо стороны не договорятся об ином», «любой срок исчисляется по времени Алма-Аты (UTC+6)». С 1 марта 2024 года на всей территории Казахстана применяется UTC+5 (постановление Правительства Республики Казахстан от 19 января 2024 года № 20). Местное время Алма-Аты и UTC+6 теперь расходятся на один час, поэтому различается и момент окончания дня по умолчанию (полночь по местному времени — это 01:00 по UTC+6). Регистратор может продлевать сроки (статья 3.8), что уменьшает практические последствия.
ru.correction: Просим выбрать в статье 3.2 одну основу исчисления времени — местное время (например, «время Астаны») или фиксированное смещение — и исключить второе обозначение.

en.title: Arbitration Regulations Art. 9(2): for foreign-seated arbitrations Articles 17 and 18 apply, but not Article 16 (stay of court proceedings)
en.summary: Article 9(2) of the AIFC Arbitration Regulations applies "Articles 17, 18, Part 3, and the Schedule" where the seat is outside the AIFC. Article 16 (what the AIFC Court must do when an action is brought in a matter that is subject to an arbitration agreement) is not listed. In the UNCITRAL Model Law (article 1(2)) the corresponding articles 8 and 9 apply whatever the place of arbitration. The AIFC Court can still stay proceedings under its general powers (section 27(2)(g) of the Court Regulations, rule 8.8 of the Court Rules), so the question is whether the Article 16 rule is meant to apply as well.
en.correction: Please confirm whether Article 16 is meant to apply where the seat is outside the AIFC.

en.title: Recognition of arbitral awards: Article 14(4) of the Constitutional Statute and Article 45(1) of the Arbitration Regulations; the English translation of Article 14(4) is narrower than the Russian and Kazakh texts
en.summary: Article 14(4) of the Constitutional Statute (Russian and Kazakh texts) provides that recognition and enforcement of arbitral awards on the territory of the Centre follow the legislation of the Republic of Kazakhstan. The English translation on aifc.kz reads "Awards of arbitration courts in the Republic of Kazakhstan", which is narrower. Article 45(1) of the AIFC Arbitration Regulations provides for recognition and enforcement by the AIFC Court of an award "irrespective of the State or jurisdiction in which it was made". The structure of Article 14 supports the narrower reading; on it, the two rules overlap only for awards made in Kazakhstan outside the AIFC. We do not claim that Article 45 cannot be applied.
en.correction: Please align the English translation of Article 14(4) with the Russian and Kazakh texts, and clarify how Article 45 of the Arbitration Regulations relates to Article 14(4).

ru.summary: Пункт 4 статьи 14 Конституционного закона Республики Казахстан «О Международном финансовом центре „Астана“» (русский и казахский тексты) предусматривает: «Признание и исполнение решений арбитражей на территории Центра осуществляются в соответствии с законодательством Республики Казахстан». Английский перевод на aifc.kz говорит о «решениях арбитражей в Республике Казахстан», что уже. Статья 45(1) Арбитражного регламента МФЦА предусматривает признание и исполнение Судом МФЦА арбитражного решения «независимо от государства или юрисдикции, в которых оно вынесено». Структура статьи 14 поддерживает более узкое прочтение; при нём две нормы пересекаются только в отношении решений, вынесенных в Казахстане вне МФЦА. Мы не утверждаем, что статья 45 не может применяться.
ru.correction: Просим привести английский перевод пункта 4 статьи 14 в соответствие с русским и казахским текстами и пояснить, как статья 45 Арбитражного регламента соотносится с пунктом 4 статьи 14.

en.title: FAR 52.225-9(b)(3)(i) and 52.225-11(b)(4)(i): headings (A) and (B) overlap when a material is a critical item or contains critical components, but not both

en.impact: No affected award has been established while the list of critical items is reserved.
en.correction: Use “and” in heading (A) of both clauses, as in 25.204(b)(1).

en.title: FAR 25.205(c): should the minimum consideration for a postaward exception cite 25.204 directly?
en.summary: FAR 25.205(c) sets the minimum consideration for a postaward exception based on unreasonable price by reference to the amount “established in 25.202(a) or in accordance with agency procedures”. Paragraph 25.202(a)(3) sets no amount; it points onward to 25.204, which adds 20 percent of the cost of the foreign construction material. Clauses 52.225-9(c)(2) and 52.225-11(c)(2) state their own minimum by reference to the evaluation factor in each clause. One reading takes the reference to 25.202(a) to reach the 25.204 factor through (a)(3). The other reads 25.202(a) as naming no amount, so that the minimum comes from agency procedures or the clause.
en.impact: No contract with a different consideration amount under either reading has been established.
en.correction: Please consider whether 25.205(c) should cite 25.204 directly.

en.impact: No award that would come out differently under the two texts has been established.
en.correction: Please consider whether 52.225-9 should use the same conditions as Part 25 for both the triggering low offer and the selected offer.

en.title: FAR 25.106(c)(1)(ii) and (c)(2)(ii): should the critical-item price tests name the critical calculation expressly?

Paragraph (a)(1) directs use of the factors in paragraphs (b) and (c), paragraph (c)(1)(i) specifies the critical calculation, and (c)(2)(i)(B) expressly applies the factors in (c)(1). en.title: FAR 25.202(a)(2): should the relief from a nonavailability determination state that it applies when the fallback procedures are used?

Those paragraphs set the fallback procedures and their conditions. The 2022 final rule preamble says the language clarifies that a determination is not required when the fallback procedures are used. One reading applies the sentence whenever such an offer exists. The other reads it, with the cross-reference and the preamble, as limited to cases in which the fallback procedures are used.
en.impact: No acquisition with an offer above 55 percent in which the fallback procedures did not apply has been established.
en.correction: Please consider whether 25.202(a)(2) should state that condition expressly.

en.impact: No contract with a different result under the two texts has been established.
en.correction: Please consider whether Part 225 should also list components, as the statute and clause already do.

en.title: 10 U.S.C. 4872(e): how should a statutory national-security waiver be reflected in clause 252.225-7961?
en.summary: Section 4872(e)(1) allows the Secretary to accept delivery of an end item containing covered material manufactured in a covered nation on a written determination that acceptance is necessary to the national security interests of the United States. Paragraph (e)(3) allows a waiver made under 4863(k) to be applied to these restrictions. Case 2024-D014 covers the amendment that made those waivers applicable. The procedure in the deviation and clause 252.225-7961(c) provide for a nonavailability determination and do not describe these waiver paths. One reading lets a valid waiver govern delivery without a change to the clause. The other requires the contract restriction to be modified to reflect it.
en.impact: No end item accepted or refused under such a waiver has been established.
en.correction: Please clarify how a valid statutory waiver should be reflected in the applicable contract restriction while implementation is pending.

en.title: 2 CFR 184.6(a)(4): how does the fiber optic cable standard implement the statutory requirement for input manufacturing?
en.summary: Section 70915(b)(2)(A) of the Build America, Buy America Act directs OMB to ensure that its standards require that each manufacturing process required for the manufacture of the construction material and its inputs occurs in the United States. For fiber optic cable, 2 CFR 184.6(a)(4) requires ribboning (where applicable), buffering, fiber stranding and jacketing in the United States. It includes the glass and optical fiber standards and excludes the standards for non-ferrous metals, plastic and polymer-based products, and other materials. The 2023 preamble explains why OMB treated the cable as a single construction material with its own standard. One reading treats the listed processes as the definition Congress delegated to OMB. The other asks whether the manufacture of polymer and other non-fiber inputs before jacketing is also required.
en.impact: No project or product with a different result has been established. Excluding another material's standard does not by itself show that a required process was omitted.
en.correction: Please clarify how the starting points in 184.6(a)(4) and the treatment of non-fiber cable inputs implement section 70915(b)(2)(A).

en.title: 2 CFR 184.6(a)(8): how does the engineered wood standard implement the statutory requirement for input manufacturing?
en.summary: Section 70915(b)(2)(A) of the Build America, Buy America Act directs OMB to ensure that its standards require that each manufacturing process required for the manufacture of the construction material and its inputs occurs in the United States. For engineered wood, 2 CFR 184.6(a)(8) covers all manufacturing processes from the initial combination of constituent materials until the wood product is in its final form. The 2023 preamble says that only the engineered wood standard applies, even though the lumber and polymer standards could otherwise apply, and explains the standard by the manufacturing processes used in the industry. One reading treats the combination of constituents as the starting point OMB chose under its delegated authority. The other asks whether the manufacture of previously manufactured lumber inputs is also required.
en.impact: No project or product with a different result has been established.
en.correction: Please clarify how the starting point in 184.6(a)(8) and the treatment of previously manufactured lumber inputs implement section 70915(b)(2)(A).

findings.act: CSS Cascading and Inheritance Level 6 (Editor's Draft, 28 April 2026)

en.title: CSS Cascade 6: §3.5.1 says scope proximity wins regardless of specificity, while §3.1 compares specificity first
en.summary: §3.5.1 of the Editor's Draft says the cascade prefers the more proximate scoping root “regardless of specificity”. §3.1 lists Specificity before Scope Proximity, and the changes list records “Removed strong scope proximity” after the Working Group resolved in issue 6790 that proximity is weaker than specificity. The §3.5.1 sentence still describes the old rule; the Working Draft of 6 September 2024 has the same sentence.
en.impact: #page img { border-radius: 0 } (specificity 1,0,1) against @scope (#hero) { img { border-radius: 50% } } (0,0,1) for an image inside #hero: by §3.1 the radius is 0, by the §3.5.1 sentence it is 50%.
en.correction: Reword the §3.5.1 sentence to match §3.1: proximity decides only when all earlier cascade criteria tie.

quotes.source: CSS Cascading and Inheritance Level 6, Editor's Draft of 28 April 2026 (W3C CSS Working Group)

en.title: CSS Cascade 6: an example of overlapping scopes in §3.5.1 does not follow the current definition of scoping limits
en.summary: The last block of example #example-463550a5 uses to ([data-scope] > *) and says both sections are part of the outer scope. Under §3.5.2 and §3.5.4 the scope end is an ordinary selector list, so both children of the outer section, a p and the inner section, are scoping limits and are out of scope. The example holds only if the scope end is matched relative to :scope, which open issue 13290 proposes; the note was sent there as a comment.
en.impact: With the example's HTML, the current text applies section { background: snow } to no section and p { color: red } to no p; the example says the inner section is styled by both scopes.
en.correction: Once issue 13290 is resolved, check the example against the chosen definition, for example by using to (:scope [data-scope] > *).

en.title: CSS Cascade 5: the Layer Ordering example gives two different orders when both media queries match
en.summary: Example #example-87e2d331 in §6.4.3 says that when the width query matches, layout comes first, and that when the colour-scheme query matches, theme comes first. When both match, the two sentences give different orders. The rule of §6.4.3 (layers sort by first declaration) gives layout first; only the second sentence is wrong. The 2022 snapshot of the specification (13 January 2022) has the same example.
en.impact: A wide viewport with a dark colour-scheme preference and the same property in both layers: by the rule the later layer, theme, wins; by the second sentence of the example layout wins.

en.title: CSS Cascade 5: what does revert-rule roll back in a style attribute?
en.summary: §7.3.6 rolls revert-rule back “as if the current style rule had not been present”. §6.1 separates declarations in a style attribute from style rules, and §7.3.6 has a sentence for the animation origin but none for the style attribute. The same question for revert-layer was settled in issue 6743 with a dedicated sentence in §7.3.5. Browsers already agree on normal declarations: the web-platform-tests case for a style attribute passes in Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari with the 5px result (stable runs of 31 October 2026); no test covers !important.

en.title: AI Act, Portuguese and Croatian versions: the 10^25 threshold of Article 51(2) is measured per second
en.summary: The other 22 versions measure the cumulative amount of computation in floating point operations, without a time unit. The added words do not fit the cumulative quantity described in the same paragraph. Recital 111 and Annex XIII, point (c), support a total number of operations.
en.impact: In a hypothetical case with a constant training rate, 2×10^25 operations over a million seconds means 2×10^19 operations per second. The total is above 10^25; the rate is not.
en.correction: Delete the words per second (por segundo, u sekundi) in Article 51(2).

quote_translations.q2: expressed as the number of floating point operations per second

pt.title: Regulamento da Inteligência Artificial, versões portuguesa e croata: o limiar de 10^25 do artigo 51.º, n.º 2, é medido por segundo
pt.summary: As outras 22 versões medem a quantidade acumulada de cálculo em operações de vírgula flutuante, sem unidade de tempo. As palavras acrescentadas não correspondem à quantidade acumulada descrita no mesmo número. O considerando 111 e o anexo XIII, alínea c), apontam para um número total de operações.
pt.impact: Num caso hipotético com uma taxa de treino constante, 2×10^25 operações ao longo de um milhão de segundos correspondem a 2×10^19 operações por segundo. O total é superior a 10^25; a taxa não é.
pt.correction: Suprimir, no artigo 51.º, n.º 2, as palavras «por segundo» na versão portuguesa e «u sekundi» na versão croata.

hr.title: Akt o umjetnoj inteligenciji, portugalska i hrvatska verzija: prag od 10^25 iz članka 51. stavka 2. mjeri se u sekundi
hr.summary: Ostale 22 verzije mjere kumulativnu količinu računanja u matematičkim operacijama nad brojevima s pomičnim zarezom, bez jedinice vremena. Dodane riječi ne odgovaraju kumulativnoj količini opisanoj u istom stavku. Uvodna izjava 111. i Prilog XIII. točka (c) upućuju na ukupan broj operacija.
hr.impact: U hipotetskom slučaju sa stalnom brzinom treniranja, 2×10^25 operacija tijekom milijun sekundi znači 2×10^19 operacija u sekundi. Ukupan broj veći je od 10^25; brzina nije.
hr.correction: U članku 51. stavku 2. brisati riječi „por segundo” u portugalskoj verziji i „u sekundi” u hrvatskoj verziji.

el.title: Κανονισμός για την τεχνητή νοημοσύνη, ελληνική απόδοση: το πρώτο σκέλος του άρθρου 74 παράγραφος 8 παραπέμπει στο παράρτημα III χωρίς περιορισμό στο σημείο 1
el.summary: Οι άλλες 23 γλωσσικές αποδόσεις αναφέρουν συστήματα που απαριθμούνται στο σημείο 1 του παραρτήματος III. Οι περιορισμοί στα συστήματα υψηλού κινδύνου και στους αναφερόμενους σκοπούς (επιβολή του νόμου, διαχείριση των συνόρων, δικαιοσύνη και δημοκρατία) παραμένουν. en.title: AI Act: is a voter exposed to the output of a campaign tool whose recommended messages staff send on?
en.summary: Annex III, point 8(b), excludes AI systems to the output of which natural persons are not directly exposed. A campaign tool ranks voters and recommends which message each voter should receive; campaign staff then send those messages. The text does not say whether this counts as direct exposure to the output of the system, read with recital 62.
en.impact: Whether the campaign tool falls under point 8(b) depends on whether the voter counts as directly exposed to its output: the internal ranking or the message the voter receives.
en.correction: The guidelines could say whether mediated exposure of this kind is direct exposure.

en.title: AI Act: which evaluation satisfies Article 82(1) when a compliant system presents only a risk to another public interest?
en.summary: Article 82(1) applies, having performed an evaluation under Article 79, to a compliant high-risk AI system that presents a risk, including a risk to other aspects of public interest protection. Article 79(2) requires an evaluation for risks to health, safety or fundamental rights, and Article 74(1) applies the general market surveillance framework of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020. The text does not say which evaluation satisfies Article 82(1) where the only risk is to another public interest.
en.impact: For an authority that finds only a risk to another public interest, the text does not say which evaluation lets it act under Article 82.
en.correction: The guidelines could say which evaluation applies.

en.title: Rome II, Greek version: should Article 11(1) on negotiorum gestio refer to unjust enrichment, as the 2014 corrigendum made it?
en.summary: The Greek corrigendum of 31 December 2014 replaced, in Article 11(1), the words with this non-contractual obligation by with that unjust enrichment. Article 11 is about negotiorum gestio, and the original Greek wording, like the other versions, tied the connection to that obligation. The same corrigendum also corrected Article 10(1), on unjust enrichment.
en.impact: A court that reads the Greek text looks for the country most closely connected with an unjust enrichment that may not exist in a case of negotiorum gestio.
en.correction: The lawyer-linguists could say whether the wording should be aligned with the other versions: restore the original Greek wording of Article 11(1).

en.title: Rome I, Croatian version: does Article 8(2) on employment contracts apply in the absence of a choice of law, as in the other versions?
en.summary: The other 23 versions open paragraph 2 with the absence of a choice by the parties. The Croatian opening repeats the condition of paragraph 3 and makes paragraph 2 depend on paragraph 2 itself. Croatian corrigenda 32008R0593R(04) and R(06) do not touch Article 8.
en.impact: For an employee who habitually works in one country under a contract without a choice of law, the Croatian text does not clearly state that the law of that country applies.
en.correction: The lawyer-linguists could say whether the wording should be aligned with the other versions: open Croatian Article 8(2) with the absence of a choice of law by the parties, as in the other versions.

hr.summary: Ostale 23 verzije započinju stavak 2. uvjetom da stranke nisu izabrale mjerodavno pravo. Hrvatski uvodni dio ponavlja uvjet iz stavka 3. i čini stavak 2. ovisnim o samom stavku 2. Hrvatski ispravci 32008R0593R(04) i R(06) ne mijenjaju članak 8.

en.summary: The other versions say that the parties may choose one of the listed laws in accordance with Article 3 (freedom of choice). The Danish text says in accordance with paragraph 3, the paragraph in which the words stand.

en.title: Rome I, Latvian version: does Article 11(1) on formal validity cover persons in the same country, as in the other versions?
en.summary: The other versions cover in paragraph 1 a contract between persons in the same country and in paragraph 2 persons in different countries. In the Latvian text both paragraphs cover persons in different countries.
en.impact: For a contract signed by two parties in the same country, the Latvian text of paragraphs 1 and 2 gives no rule on which laws can make it formally valid.
en.correction: The lawyer-linguists could say whether the wording should be aligned with the other versions: replace different countries with the same country in Latvian Article 11(1).

lv.title: Roma I, latviešu valodas versija: vai 11. panta 1. punkts par līguma formālo spēkā esamību attiecas uz personām, kas atrodas vienā un tajā pašā valstī, kā citās versijās?
lv.summary: Pārējās versijās 1. punkts attiecas uz līgumu starp personām, kas atrodas vienā un tajā pašā valstī, bet 2. punkts — uz līgumu starp personām, kas atrodas dažādās valstīs. Latviešu tekstā abi punkti attiecas uz personām, kas atrodas dažādās valstīs.
lv.impact: Attiecībā uz līgumu, ko parakstījušas divas puses vienā un tajā pašā valstī, latviešu teksta 1. un 2. punkts nenosaka, saskaņā ar kuras valsts tiesību aktiem līgums var būt formāli spēkā.
lv.correction: Juristi lingvisti varētu norādīt, vai formulējums būtu jāsaskaņo ar pārējām valodu versijām: latviešu teksta 11. panta 1. punktā vārdus „dažādās valstīs“ aizstāt ar vārdiem „vienā un tajā pašā valstī“.

en.title: Rome II, Croatian version: Articles 5(1) and 9 refer to Article 42(2), and Rome II has 32 articles
en.summary: The other versions of Article 5(1) (product liability) and Article 9 (industrial action) begin without prejudice to Article 4(2), the rule on common habitual residence. The Croatian text refers to Article 42(2). There is no Croatian corrigendum to Rome II.
en.impact: In the Croatian text, the priority of the common habitual residence of the parties in product liability and industrial action cases is referred to an article that does not exist.
en.correction: Replace 42. with 4. in Croatian Article 5(1) and Article 9.

hr.title: Rim II, hrvatska verzija: članak 5. stavak 1. i članak 9. upućuju na članak 42. stavak 2., a Rim II ima 32 članka

(industrijska akcija) počinju upućivanjem koje znači „ne dovodeći u pitanje članak 4. stavak 2.”, odnosno pravilo prema kojem se primjenjuje pravo države u kojoj obje stranke imaju uobičajeno boravište. Hrvatski tekst upućuje na članak 42. stavak 2. Za hrvatsku verziju Rima II nije objavljen ispravak.

en.title: Rome I, Croatian and Dutch versions: does the escape clause for employment contracts set the same test as the other versions?
en.summary: The other versions ask whether the contract is more closely connected with another country. The Croatian text asks for the closest connection; the Dutch text asks for a manifestly closer connection, and no other version has manifestly in this paragraph.
en.impact: The same employment contract can pass the escape clause in one version and fail it in another.
en.correction: The lawyer-linguists could say whether the wording should be aligned with the other versions: align Croatian and Dutch Article 8(4) with the other versions.

quote_translations.q1: in the closest connection

hr.title: Rim I, hrvatska i nizozemska verzija: postavlja li klauzula o odstupanju za ugovore o radu isti kriterij kao druge verzije?
hr.summary: Druge verzije pitaju je li ugovor u bližoj vezi s nekom drugom državom. Hrvatski tekst traži najbližu vezu („u najbližoj vezi“); nizozemski tekst traži očito bližu vezu („kennelijk nauwere band“), a nijedna druga verzija u ovom stavku nema riječ očito.
hr.impact: Isti ugovor o radu može ispuniti uvjete za primjenu klauzule o odstupanju prema jednoj verziji, a ne ispuniti ih prema drugoj.
hr.correction: Pravnici lingvisti mogli bi reći treba li tekst uskladiti s drugim jezičnim verzijama: uskladiti članak 8. stavak 4. hrvatske i nizozemske verzije s drugim verzijama.

nl.title: Rome I, Kroatische en Nederlandse versie: hanteert de uitwijkclausule voor arbeidsovereenkomsten hetzelfde criterium als de andere versies?
nl.summary: De andere versies vragen of de overeenkomst nauwer verbonden is met een ander land. De Kroatische tekst vraagt om de nauwste band („u najbližoj vezi”); de Nederlandse tekst vraagt om een „kennelijk nauwere band”, en geen andere versie bevat in dit lid het woord kennelijk.
nl.impact: Dezelfde arbeidsovereenkomst kan in de ene versie aan de voorwaarden voor toepassing van de uitwijkclausule voldoen en in een andere niet.
nl.correction: De juristen-linguïsten zouden kunnen aangeven of de formulering in overeenstemming moet worden gebracht met de andere taalversies: artikel 8, lid 4, van de Kroatische en de Nederlandse versie in overeenstemming brengen met de andere versies.

en.correction: The lawyer-linguists could say whether the wording should be aligned with the other versions: align Latvian and Estonian Article 7(2), second subparagraph, with the other versions.

et.title: Rooma I, läti ja eesti keeleversioon: kas suuri riske katvate kindlustuslepingute erandiklausli kohaldamiseks peab selgelt ilmnema, et leping on ilmselgelt tihedamalt seotud teise riigiga?
et.summary: Teised versioonid nõuavad, et kõikidest asjaoludest ilmneks selgelt, et leping on ilmselgelt tihedamalt seotud mõne teise riigiga. Läti tekstis puudub sõna, mis vastaks sõnadele selgelt või ilmselgelt; eesti tekstis on säilinud sõna „selgelt“, kuid mitte ilmselgelt („ilmneb selgelt, et leping on tihedamalt seotud“).
et.impact: Läti ja eesti teksti järgi piisab nõrgemast seosest, et kindlustusandja riigi õigus kõrvale jätta.
et.correction: Juristlingvistid võiksid öelda, kas sõnastus tuleks viia kooskõlla teiste keeleversioonidega: viia läti ja eesti teksti artikli 7 lõike 2 teine lõik kooskõlla teiste versioonidega.

lv.title: Roma I, latviešu un igauņu valodas versija: vai izņēmuma klauzula par lielu risku apdrošināšanu prasa, lai būtu skaidrs, ka līgums ir acīmredzami ciešāk saistīts ar citu valsti?
lv.summary: Pārējās versijas prasa, lai no visiem lietas apstākļiem būtu skaidrs, ka līgums ir acīmredzami ciešāk saistīts ar citu valsti. Latviešu tekstā nav vārda, kas atbilstu vārdiem skaidrs vai acīmredzami („Ja lietas apstākļu kopums liecina, ka līgums ir ciešāk saistīts“); igauņu tekstā ir saglabāts vārds skaidri, bet nav vārda acīmredzami.
lv.impact: Saskaņā ar latviešu un igauņu tekstu pietiek ar vājāku saikni, lai atkāptos no apdrošinātāja valsts tiesību aktu piemērošanas.
lv.correction: Juristi lingvisti varētu norādīt, vai formulējums būtu jāsaskaņo ar pārējām valodu versijām: saskaņot latviešu un igauņu teksta 7. panta 2. punkta otro daļu ar pārējām versijām.

en.title: Rome I, six versions: does Article 7(3) limit the choice for mass risks to the law of a Member State?
en.summary: In points (a) and (c) of Article 7(3) most versions limit the choice for mass-risk insurance to the law of a Member State. The Slovak, Dutch and Finnish texts of point (a) and the Swedish, Estonian and Slovenian texts of point (c) speak of a country or state.
en.impact: Read alone, these texts allow the choice of the law of a third country for a mass risk.
en.correction: The lawyer-linguists could say whether the wording should be aligned with the other versions: say Member State in the six versions, as in the others.

quote_translations.q1: of any country

et.title: Rooma I, kuus keeleversiooni: kas artikli 7 lõige 3 piirab massriskide puhul valikut liikmesriigi õigusega?
et.summary: Artikli 7 lõike 3 punktides a ja c piirab enamik versioone massriskide kindlustuse puhul valikut liikmesriigi õigusega. Slovaki, hollandi ja soome tekst punktis a ning rootsi, eesti ja sloveeni tekst punktis c kasutavad liikmesriigi asemel maad või riiki tähistavat sõna.
et.impact: Eraldi lugedes lubavad need tekstid massriski puhul valida kolmanda riigi õiguse.
et.correction: Juristlingvistid võiksid öelda, kas sõnastus tuleks viia kooskõlla teiste keeleversioonidega: kasutada kõigis kuues versioonis sõna „liikmesriik“, nagu teistes versioonides.

fi.title: Rooma I, kuusi kieliversiota: rajoittaako 7 artiklan 3 kohta massariskien osalta lakivalinnan jäsenvaltion lakiin?
fi.summary: Useimmat kieliversiot rajoittavat 7 artiklan 3 kohdan a ja c alakohdassa massariskien vakuutusten lakivalinnan jäsenvaltion lakiin. Slovakin-, hollannin- ja suomenkielinen teksti a alakohdassa sekä ruotsin-, viron- ja sloveeninkielinen teksti c alakohdassa puhuvat maasta tai valtiosta.
fi.impact: Yksinään luettuina nämä tekstit sallivat kolmannen maan lain valitsemisen massariskin vakuuttamiseen.
fi.correction: Lakimieslingvistit voisivat todeta, pitäisikö sanamuoto yhdenmukaistaa muiden kieliversioiden kanssa: käyttää kaikissa kuudessa kieliversiossa sanaa ”jäsenvaltio”, kuten muissa kieliversioissa.

nl.title: Rome I, zes versies: beperkt artikel 7, lid 3, de keuze voor massarisico's tot het recht van een lidstaat?
nl.summary: In artikel 7, lid 3, onder a) en c), beperken de meeste versies de keuze voor verzekering van massarisico's tot het recht van een lidstaat. De Slowaakse, Nederlandse en Finse tekst onder a) en de Zweedse, Estse en Sloveense tekst onder c) spreken van een land of staat.
nl.impact: Op zichzelf gelezen staan deze teksten toe dat voor een massarisico het recht van een derde land wordt gekozen.
nl.correction: De juristen-linguïsten zouden kunnen aangeven of de formulering in overeenstemming moet worden gebracht met de andere taalversies: in de zes versies „lidstaat” schrijven, zoals in de andere versies.

sk.title: Rím I, šesť jazykových znení: obmedzuje článok 7 ods. 3 voľbu pri hromadných rizikách na právny poriadok členského štátu?
sk.summary: V písmenách a) a c) článku 7 ods. 3 väčšina znení obmedzuje voľbu pri poistení hromadných rizík na právny poriadok členského štátu. Slovenské, holandské a fínske znenie písmena a) a švédske, estónske a slovinské znenie písmena c) hovoria o krajine alebo štáte.
sk.impact: Ak sa čítajú samostatne, tieto znenia umožňujú pri hromadnom riziku zvoliť právny poriadok tretej krajiny.
sk.correction: Právnici lingvisti by mohli posúdiť, či by sa znenie malo zosúladiť s ostatnými jazykovými zneniami: uviesť v šiestich zneniach „členský štát“, ako v ostatných zneniach.

sl.title: Rim I, šest jezikovnih različic: ali člen 7(3) omejuje izbiro pri zavarovanju nevarnosti, ki niso velike, na pravo države članice?
sl.summary: V točkah (a) in (c) člena 7(3) večina različic omejuje izbiro pri zavarovanju nevarnosti, ki niso velike, na pravo države članice. Slovaško, nizozemsko in finsko besedilo točke (a) ter švedsko, estonsko in slovensko besedilo točke (c) govorijo o državi, ne da bi jo opredelili kot državo članico.
sl.impact: Če se berejo sama zase, ta besedila dopuščajo izbiro prava tretje države za zavarovanje nevarnosti, ki ni velika.
sl.correction: Pravniki lingvisti bi lahko povedali, ali bi bilo treba besedilo uskladiti z drugimi jezikovnimi različicami: v šestih različicah zapisati „država članica“, kot v drugih različicah.

sv.title: Rom I, sex språkversioner: begränsar artikel 7.3 valet för massrisker till lagen i en medlemsstat?
sv.summary: I artikel 7.3 a och c begränsar de flesta versioner valet för försäkring av massrisker till lagen i en medlemsstat. Den slovakiska, nederländska och finska texten i led a och den svenska, estniska och slovenska texten i led c talar om ett land eller en stat.
sv.impact: Lästa för sig tillåter dessa texter att lagen i ett tredjeland väljs för en massrisk.
sv.correction: Juristlingvisterna skulle kunna säga om lydelsen bör anpassas till de andra språkversionerna: skriva ”medlemsstat” i de sex versionerna, som i de övriga.

findings.location: Article 4(1)(h), Lithuanian, Greek, Maltese, Hungarian and Danish versions

en.title: Rome I, five versions: are multilateral trading systems in Article 4(1)(h) defined by non-discretionary rules?
en.summary: Article 4(1)(h) covers contracts in a multilateral system that brings together interests in financial instruments in accordance with non-discretionary rules. The Lithuanian, Greek, Maltese and Hungarian texts say non-discriminatory; the Danish text says mandatory.
en.impact: A trading venue whose operator has discretion can fall under point (h) in one version and outside it in another.
en.correction: The lawyer-linguists could say whether the wording should be aligned with the other versions: align the five versions with the term non-discretionary.

quote_translations.q1: non-discriminatory rules

da.title: Rom I, fem sprogversioner: er multilaterale handelssystemer i artikel 4, stk. 1, litra h), defineret ved ikke-skønsmæssige regler?
da.summary: Artikel 4, stk. 1, litra h), omfatter aftaler indgået i et multilateralt system, der samler interesser i finansielle instrumenter efter ikke-skønsmæssige regler. Den litauiske, græske, maltesiske og ungarske tekst siger ikke-diskriminerende; den danske tekst siger »ufravigelige regler«.
da.impact: Et handelssted, hvis operatør har skønsbeføjelser, kan i én version falde ind under litra h) og i en anden falde uden for bestemmelsen.
da.correction: Juristlingvisterne kunne tage stilling til, om ordlyden bør bringes i overensstemmelse med de andre sprogversioner: bringe de fem versioner i overensstemmelse med udtrykket ikke-skønsmæssige.

el.title: Ρώμη Ι, πέντε γλωσσικές αποδόσεις: ορίζονται τα πολυμερή συστήματα διαπραγμάτευσης του άρθρου 4 παράγραφος 1 στοιχείο η) με βάση κανόνες που δεν παρέχουν διακριτική ευχέρεια;
el.summary: Το άρθρο 4 παράγραφος 1 στοιχείο η) καλύπτει συμβάσεις που συνάπτονται σε πολυμερές σύστημα το οποίο συγκεντρώνει συμφέροντα επί χρηματοπιστωτικών μέσων σύμφωνα με κανόνες που δεν παρέχουν διακριτική ευχέρεια. Τα κείμενα στη λιθουανική, την ελληνική, τη μαλτεζική και την ουγγρική γλώσσα κάνουν λόγο για κανόνες χωρίς διακρίσεις («κανόνες που δεν κάνουν διακρίσεις»)· το δανικό κείμενο κάνει λόγο για υποχρεωτικούς κανόνες.
el.impact: Ένας τόπος διαπραγμάτευσης του οποίου ο διαχειριστής έχει διακριτική ευχέρεια μπορεί να εμπίπτει στο στοιχείο η) σε μία γλωσσική απόδοση και να μην εμπίπτει σε άλλη.
el.correction: Οι γλωσσομαθείς νομικοί θα μπορούσαν να διευκρινίσουν αν η διατύπωση πρέπει να ευθυγραμμιστεί με τις άλλες γλωσσικές αποδόσεις: ευθυγράμμιση των πέντε γλωσσικών αποδόσεων με την έννοια των κανόνων που δεν παρέχουν διακριτική ευχέρεια.

hu.title: Róma I, öt nyelvi változat: a 4. cikk (1) bekezdésének h) pontjában szereplő multilaterális kereskedési rendszereket mérlegelést nem engedő szabályok határozzák-e meg?
hu.summary: A 4. cikk (1) bekezdésének h) pontja azokra a szerződésekre vonatkozik, amelyeket olyan multilaterális rendszerben kötnek, amely mérlegelést nem engedő szabályok szerint hozza össze a pénzügyi eszközökkel kapcsolatos érdekeket. A litván, a görög, a máltai és a magyar szöveg megkülönböztetésmentes szabályokról szól („megkülönböztetésmentes szabályokkal”); a dán szöveg kötelező szabályokról.
hu.impact: Az a kereskedési helyszín, amelynek üzemeltetője mérlegelési jogkörrel rendelkezik, az egyik változatban a h) pont hatálya alá tartozhat, egy másikban pedig nem.
hu.correction: A jogász-nyelvészek megítélhetnék, hogy a szöveget össze kell-e hangolni a többi nyelvi változattal: az öt nyelvi változat összehangolása a „mérlegelést nem engedő” kifejezéssel.

lt.title: Roma I, penkios kalbinės versijos: ar 4 straipsnio 1 dalies h punkte daugiašalės prekybos sistemos apibrėžiamos nediskrecinėmis taisyklėmis?
lt.summary: 4 straipsnio 1 dalies h punktas apima sutartis, sudarytas daugiašalėje sistemoje, kuri pagal nediskrecines taisykles suveda su finansinėmis priemonėmis susijusius interesus. Lietuvių, graikų, maltiečių ir vengrų tekstuose kalbama apie nediskriminuojančias taisykles („nediskriminuojančių taisyklių“); danų tekste kalbama apie privalomas taisykles.
lt.impact: Prekybos vieta, kurios operatorius turi diskrecijos teisę, pagal vieną versiją gali patekti į h punkto taikymo sritį, o pagal kitą ne.
lt.correction: Teisininkai lingvistai galėtų nurodyti, ar formuluotę reikėtų suderinti su kitomis kalbinėmis versijomis: suderinti penkias versijas su terminu „nediskrecinės“.

mt.title: Ruma I, ħames verżjonijiet: is-sistemi multilaterali ta' kummerċ fl-Artikolu 4(1)(h) huma definiti minn regoli mhux diskrezzjonali?
mt.summary: L-Artikolu 4(1)(h) ikopri kuntratti f'sistema multilaterali li tlaqqa' flimkien interessi fi strumenti finanzjarji skont regoli mhux diskrezzjonali. It-testi Litwan, Grieg, Malti u Ungeriż jgħidu mhux diskriminatorji (“regoli non diskriminatorji”); it-test Daniż jgħid obbligatorji.
mt.impact: Post tan-negozjar li l-operatur tiegħu għandu diskrezzjoni jista' jaqa' taħt il-punt (h) f'verżjoni waħda u ma jaqax taħtu f'oħra.
mt.correction: Il-ġuristi lingwisti jistgħu jgħidu jekk il-kliem għandux jiġi allinjat mal-verżjonijiet l-oħra: jiġu allinjati l-ħames verżjonijiet mat-terminu mhux diskrezzjonali.

findings.act: Regulation (EC) No 593/2008 (Rome I) and Regulation (EC) No 864/2007 (Rome II)
findings.location: Article 16 of Rome I and Article 20 of Rome II, Danish, Italian and Romanian versions

en.title: Rome I and Rome II, Danish, Italian and Romanian versions: does the rule on multiple liability require joint and several liability?
en.summary: Most versions apply the rule to several debtors liable for the same claim. The Danish and Italian texts of both Regulations, and the Romanian text of Rome I, say jointly and severally liable. The Romanian text of Rome II says liable together.
en.impact: Under these texts a debtor who is liable for the same claim but not jointly and severally may fall outside the rule on recourse.
en.correction: The lawyer-linguists could say whether the wording should be aligned with the other versions: align the Danish, Italian and Romanian texts with liable for the same claim.

quote_translations.q1: are jointly and severally liable

da.title: Rom I og Rom II, dansk, italiensk og rumænsk version: kræver reglen om flere skyldnere solidarisk hæftelse?
da.summary: De fleste versioner anvender reglen på flere skyldnere, der hæfter for samme fordring. Den danske og den italienske tekst af begge forordninger og den rumænske tekst af Rom I siger, at de »hæfter solidarisk«. Den rumænske tekst af Rom II siger, at de hæfter sammen.
da.impact: Efter disse tekster kan en skyldner, der hæfter for samme fordring, men ikke solidarisk med de øvrige skyldnere, falde uden for reglen om regres.
da.correction: Juristlingvisterne kunne tage stilling til, om ordlyden bør bringes i overensstemmelse med de andre sprogversioner: bringe den danske, den italienske og den rumænske tekst i overensstemmelse med udtrykket hæfter for samme fordring.

it.title: Roma I e Roma II, versioni danese, italiana e rumena: la norma sulla responsabilità di più debitori richiede la responsabilità in solido?
it.summary: La maggior parte delle versioni applica la norma a più debitori responsabili per lo stesso credito. I testi danese e italiano di entrambi i regolamenti e il testo rumeno di Roma I dicono «responsabili in solido». Il testo rumeno di Roma II dice responsabili insieme.
it.impact: Secondo questi testi, un debitore responsabile per lo stesso credito, ma non in solido con gli altri debitori, può restare escluso dalla norma sul regresso.
it.correction: I giuristi linguisti potrebbero indicare se la formulazione debba essere allineata alle altre versioni linguistiche: allineare i testi danese, italiano e rumeno alla formula responsabili per lo stesso credito.

ro.title: Roma I și Roma II, versiunile daneză, italiană și română: impune norma privind răspunderea multiplă răspunderea solidară?
ro.summary: Majoritatea versiunilor aplică norma mai multor debitori care răspund pentru aceeași creanță. Versiunile daneză și italiană ale ambelor regulamente, precum și versiunea română a Regulamentului Roma I, spun că debitorii „răspund solidar”. Textul român al Regulamentului Roma II spune că răspund în comun.
ro.impact: Potrivit acestor texte, un debitor care răspunde pentru aceeași creanță, dar nu solidar cu ceilalți debitori, poate rămâne în afara normei privind regresul.
ro.correction: Juriștii-lingviști ar putea preciza dacă formularea ar trebui aliniată cu celelalte versiuni lingvistice: alinierea textelor daneză, italiană și română la formularea răspund pentru aceeași creanță.

en.title: Rome II, Bulgarian and Slovenian versions: does Article 6(3)(b) set the same conditions as the other versions?
en.summary: Article 6(3)(b) lets the claimant rely on the law of the court where the market is affected in more than one country, if the market in that Member State is directly and substantially affected. The Bulgarian text says more than one Member State; the Slovenian text says directly or substantially.
en.impact: A claim about a market affected in one Member State and a third country can use the option in most versions but not in Bulgarian; an indirect but substantial effect is enough in Slovenian.
en.correction: The lawyer-linguists could say whether the wording should be aligned with the other versions: align Bulgarian and Slovenian Article 6(3)(b) with the other versions.

quote_translations.q1: more than one Member State

bg.title: Рим II, българска и словенска версия: поставя ли член 6, параграф 3, буква б) същите условия като другите версии?
bg.summary: Член 6, параграф 3, буква б) позволява на ищеца да се позове на правото на сезирания съд, когато пазарът е засегнат в повече от една държава, ако пазарът в тази държава-членка е засегнат непосредствено и значително. Българският текст гласи „повече от една държава-членка“; словенският текст гласи непосредствено или значително.
bg.impact: При иск относно пазар, засегнат в една държава-членка и в трета държава, ищецът може да се възползва от тази възможност според повечето версии, но не и според българската; в словенската версия е достатъчно непряко, но значително въздействие.
bg.correction: Юристите-лингвисти биха могли да преценят дали текстът следва да бъде приведен в съответствие с другите езикови версии: привеждане на член 6, параграф 3, буква б) от българската и словенската версия в съответствие с другите версии.

sl.title: Rim II, bolgarska in slovenska različica: ali člen 6(3)(b) določa enake pogoje kot druge različice?
sl.summary: Člen 6(3)(b) tožeči stranki omogoča, da se opre na pravo sodišča, kadar je trg prizadet v več kot eni državi, če je trg v tej državi članici neposredno in bistveno prizadet. Bolgarsko besedilo navaja več kot eno državo članico; slovensko besedilo navaja „neposredno ali bistveno prizadeti“.
sl.impact: Pri zahtevku glede trga, prizadetega v eni državi članici in v tretji državi, lahko tožeča stranka po večini različic uporabi to možnost, po bolgarski pa ne; v slovenski različici zadošča posreden, a bistven učinek.
sl.correction: Pravniki lingvisti bi lahko povedali, ali bi bilo treba besedilo uskladiti z drugimi jezikovnimi različicami: uskladiti člen 6(3)(b) bolgarske in slovenske različice z drugimi različicami.

en.title: Rome II, Croatian version: does Article 4(2) apply to the person claimed to be liable or only to a person whose liability is established?
en.summary: The other versions apply the common habitual residence rule to the person claimed to be liable. The Croatian text speaks of the person whose liability has been established.
en.impact: Read alone, the Croatian rule assumes liability before the applicable law that decides it has been found.
en.correction: The lawyer-linguists could say whether the wording should be aligned with the other versions: align Croatian Article 4(2) with the person claimed to be liable.

hr.title: Rim II, hrvatska verzija: primjenjuje li se članak 4. stavak 2. na osobu za koju se tvrdi da je odgovorna ili samo na osobu kojoj je odgovornost utvrđena?

en.summary: The other versions allow a freely negotiated choice before the event where all the parties pursue a commercial activity. The Croatian and Slovenian texts say both parties.

hr.title: Rim II, hrvatska i slovenska verzija: moraju li sve stranke obavljati poslovnu djelatnost za izbor prava prema članku 14. stavku 1. točki (b)?
hr.summary: Druge verzije dopuštaju slobodno ugovoren izbor prava prije nastanka događaja ako sve stranke obavljaju poslovnu djelatnost. Hrvatski i slovenski tekst govore o objema strankama („obje stranke“, „obe stranki“).
hr.impact: Kad postoje tri ili više stranaka, hrvatski i slovenski tekst ne navode mora li svaka stranka obavljati poslovnu djelatnost.
hr.correction: Pravnici lingvisti mogli bi reći treba li tekst uskladiti s drugim jezičnim verzijama: navesti sve stranke u članku 14. stavku 1. točki (b) hrvatske i slovenske verzije.

sl.title: Rim II, hrvaška in slovenska različica: ali morajo za izbiro prava po členu 14(1)(b) vse stranke opravljati gospodarsko dejavnost?
sl.summary: Druge različice dopuščajo izbiro prava, o kateri se stranke svobodno dogovorijo pred nastankom dogodka, če vse stranke opravljajo gospodarsko dejavnost. Hrvaško in slovensko besedilo govorita o obeh strankah („obje stranke“, „obe stranki“).
sl.impact: Kadar so udeležene tri stranke ali več, hrvaško in slovensko besedilo ne povesta, ali mora vsaka stranka opravljati gospodarsko dejavnost.
sl.correction: Pravniki lingvisti bi lahko povedali, ali bi bilo treba besedilo uskladiti z drugimi jezikovnimi različicami: v členu 14(1)(b) hrvaške in slovenske različice zapisati vse stranke.

en.title: Rome II, Dutch and Romanian versions: does Article 23 define habitual residence in the same way as the other versions?
en.summary: In the second subparagraph of Article 23(1) the Dutch text names a subsidiary, a branch or another establishment where the other versions name a branch, an agency or any other establishment. In Article 23(2) the Romanian text replaces a natural person acting in the course of his or her business activity with activity during working hours.
en.impact: A company's subsidiary can count as its place of habitual residence under the Dutch text, and the Romanian test turns on time rather than on the nature of the activity.
en.correction: The lawyer-linguists could say whether the wording should be aligned with the other versions: align Dutch Article 23(1) and Romanian Article 23(2) with the other versions.

quote_translations.q2: for his activity during working hours

nl.title: Rome II, Nederlandse en Roemeense versie: omschrijft artikel 23 de gewone verblijfplaats op dezelfde wijze als de andere versies?
nl.summary: In de tweede alinea van artikel 23, lid 1, noemt de Nederlandse tekst een „dochteronderneming”, een bijkantoor of een andere vestiging, waar de andere versies een bijkantoor, een agentschap of een andere vestiging noemen. In artikel 23, lid 2, vervangt de Roemeense tekst de omschrijving van een natuurlijk persoon bij de uitoefening van zijn of haar beroep door een verwijzing naar activiteit tijdens de werkuren.
nl.impact: Volgens de Nederlandse tekst kan een dochteronderneming van een vennootschap als de gewone verblijfplaats van die vennootschap gelden, en volgens de Roemeense tekst hangt het criterium af van het tijdstip in plaats van de aard van de activiteit.
nl.correction: De juristen-linguïsten zouden kunnen aangeven of de formulering in overeenstemming moet worden gebracht met de andere taalversies: artikel 23, lid 1, van de Nederlandse versie en artikel 23, lid 2, van de Roemeense versie in overeenstemming brengen met de andere versies.

ro.title: Roma II, versiunile neerlandeză și română: definește articolul 23 reședința obișnuită în același mod ca celelalte versiuni?
ro.summary: La articolul 23 alineatul (1) al doilea paragraf, textul neerlandez menționează o filială („dochteronderneming”), o sucursală sau o altă unitate, acolo unde celelalte versiuni menționează o sucursală, o agenție sau orice altă unitate. La articolul 23 alineatul (2), textul român înlocuiește persoana fizică ce acționează în cursul desfășurării activității sale profesionale cu activitatea în timpul programului de lucru („pentru activitatea sa în timpul programului de lucru”).
ro.impact: Potrivit textului neerlandez, filiala unei societăți poate fi considerată locul reședinței obișnuite a acelei societăți, iar criteriul din textul român depinde de timp, nu de natura activității.
ro.correction: Juriștii-lingviști ar putea preciza dacă formularea ar trebui aliniată cu celelalte versiuni lingvistice: alinierea articolului 23 alineatul (1) din versiunea neerlandeză și a articolului 23 alineatul (2) din versiunea română cu celelalte versiuni.

en.title: Rome II, Romanian and Lithuanian versions: does Article 15 describe the same matters as the other versions?
en.summary: In Article 15(d) the Romanian text speaks of protective measures where the other versions speak of the measures a court may take to prevent or stop injury or damage. In Article 15(h) the Lithuanian text names acquisitive prescription, which concerns property, beside the limitation of actions.
en.impact: The matters governed by the applicable law are described differently in these two versions.
en.correction: The lawyer-linguists could say whether the wording should be aligned with the other versions: align Romanian Article 15(d) and Lithuanian Article 15(h) with the other versions.

lt.title: Roma II, rumunų ir lietuvių kalbų versijos: ar 15 straipsnyje aprašomi tie patys klausimai kaip kitose versijose?
lt.summary: 15 straipsnio d punkte rumunų tekste kalbama apie apsaugos priemones, o kitose versijose – apie priemones, kurių teismas gali imtis, kad užkirstų kelią pažeidimui ar žalai arba nutrauktų pažeidimą ar žalos darymą. 15 straipsnio h punkte lietuvių tekstas šalia ieškinio senaties nurodo įgyjamąją senatį, kuri susijusi su nuosavybe („įgyjamosios senaties ir ieškininės senaties“).
lt.impact: Taikytinos teisės reglamentuojami klausimai šiose dviejose versijose aprašyti skirtingai.
lt.correction: Teisininkai lingvistai galėtų nurodyti, ar formuluotę reikėtų suderinti su kitomis kalbinėmis versijomis: suderinti rumunų teksto 15 straipsnio d punktą ir lietuvių teksto 15 straipsnio h punktą su kitomis versijomis.

ro.title: Roma II, versiunile română și lituaniană: descrie articolul 15 aceleași aspecte ca celelalte versiuni?

La articolul 15 litera (h), textul lituanian menționează prescripția achizitivă, care privește proprietatea, alături de prescripția extinctivă.
ro.impact: Aspectele reglementate de legea aplicabilă sunt descrise diferit în aceste două versiuni.
ro.correction: Juriștii-lingviști ar putea preciza dacă formularea ar trebui aliniată cu celelalte versiuni lingvistice: alinierea articolului 15 litera (d) din versiunea română și a articolului 15 litera (h) din versiunea lituaniană cu celelalte versiuni.

en.title: Rome I: which Member State prevails when two Member States impose conflicting compulsory insurance on the same risk?
en.summary: Point (a) of Article 7(4) gives priority to the law of the Member State imposing the obligation to take out insurance, and point (b) lets each such State require the contract to be governed by its law. en.impact: Two courts can each apply their own State's compulsory insurance law to the same policy.
en.correction: The Commission's work on the application of the Regulation could say which State prevails.

en.title: Rome II: at what time is foreseeability assessed under Article 5(1), second subparagraph?
en.summary: The law of the habitual residence of the person claimed to be liable applies if that person could not reasonably foresee the marketing of the product. en.title: Rome II: which event must a choice of law follow under Article 14(1)(a) when several events give rise to the damage?
en.summary: Article 14(1)(a) allows a choice by an agreement entered into after the event giving rise to the damage. en.impact: An agreement made between the earliest and the last event can be valid under one reading and invalid under the other.
en.correction: The Commission's work on the application of the Regulation could say which event counts.

en.title: UAX #14 rev. 57, Section 9.1: the rewritten rules do not give the same result as LB9 and LB10
en.summary: Section 9.1 says the rules from LB11 on can be rewritten so that “the overall result of the algorithm is unchanged”: replace LB10 by “× CM” and add a CM copy of every rule with AL on its left side. Applied literally, the rewrite differs from Section 6.1 in three cases: a space before a combining mark (no break instead of the LB18 break), ZWJ, which LB9 treats like CM but Section 9.1 does not mention, and AL-to-CM copies that also match marks attached to other bases. On 1,099 of the 19,346 lines of LineBreakTest.txt, 58 lines give a different result.
en.impact: U+0061 LATIN SMALL LETTER A, U+0020 SPACE, U+0301 COMBINING ACUTE ACCENT, U+0062 LATIN SMALL LETTER B: Section 6.1 gives a break between the space and the accent, the rewrite of Section 9.1 gives none.
en.correction: Keep the treatment of SPACE, ZWJ and combining marks that already have a base in Section 9.1, or qualify the sentence that the overall result is unchanged.

en.title: Wage-tax program 2026, XML: the VJAHR input has a misspelled “defaul” attribute
en.summary: In the XML version of the 2026 wage-tax program, the input VJAHR (the year pension payments began) is declared with the attribute “defaul”. The other inputs with a default value use “default”. This is the only occurrence in the file.
en.impact: What a program does with this input when no value is passed depends on how it reads the file. No incorrect tax amount has been shown.
en.correction: Write “default” in the VJAHR declaration.

en.title: Wage-tax program 2026 cites § 19a(1) sentence 4 EStG for non-taxed share benefits; the rule is in sentence 6
en.summary: The XML version cites sentence 4 in four places, including the comment on input MBV, and the PDF cites it in three explanations of output values. Sentence 4 deals with when a benefit counts as received. Sentence 6 deals with non-taxed benefits and the provision for social insurance contributions, and the PDF's own input table gives sentence 6 for MBV. The draft program for 2027 of 8 October 2026 still cites sentence 4.
en.impact: Readers of the program are sent to the wrong sentence. The tax calculation does not change.
en.correction: Replace “Satz 4” with “Satz 6” in these references.

quote_translations.s4: A benefit within the meaning of sentence 1 is in this case also deemed received
quote_translations.s6: A non-taxed benefit within the meaning of sentence 1 is to be included when calculating the provision for social insurance contributions

de.title: PAP 2026 nennt für nicht besteuerte Vorteile § 19a Abs. 1 Satz 4 EStG; einschlägig ist Satz 6
de.summary: Die XML-Fassung nennt Satz 4 an vier Stellen, darunter im Kommentar zum Eingangsparameter MBV, das PDF in drei Erläuterungen zu Ausgangsgrößen. Satz 4 betrifft den Zeitpunkt des Zuflusses. Satz 6 betrifft den nicht besteuerten Vorteil und die Vorsorgepauschale; die Tabelle der Eingangsparameter im PDF nennt für MBV selbst Satz 6. Der Entwurf des PAP 2027 vom 8. Oktober 2026 nennt weiterhin Satz 4.
de.impact: Der Verweis führt zum falschen Satz. Die Steuerberechnung ändert sich nicht.
de.correction: In diesen Verweisen „Satz 4“ durch „Satz 6“ ersetzen.
